handbookNote: Batch 2 depth expansion for the Wisconsin Notary practice-question pool -- same source grounding as batch 1 (Wisconsin Statutes Chapter 140, the Revised Uniform Law on Notarial Acts (2018), confirmed directly against docs.legis.wisconsin.gov and dfi.wi.gov on 2026-08-15, plus DFI's published fee/renewal/tutorial procedural facts), going deeper into definitional subsections (140.01(3)-(5),(10)-(11),(13)-(16),(18)), fee-schedule and DFI rulemaking detail (140.02(9), 140.27), certificate-execution mechanics (140.15(1)(b),(3),(5),(6), 140.02(3)-(4), 140.18(1)(c)), officer-determination duties for verification/witnessing/copy-certification/protest (140.05(2)-(5), 140.07(2)(a)2.,(3)), the prima-facie-vs-conclusive evidentiary tier structure across interstate/tribal/federal/foreign recognition (140.11-140.14, 140.30), and the two large remote-notarization sections only lightly touched by batch 1 -- general remote notarial acts and the Remote Notary Council (140.145) and remote execution of estate planning documents under attorney supervision (140.147) -- plus scenario/application and common-error-pattern questions applying already-established rules to new fact patterns; price matches this project's established $9.99 Notary tier
